title: Database disk full from runaway export job
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the PostgreSQL disk being filled by the export cron job.
root_cause: The data‑export cron job fills /var/lib/postgresql/exports, exhausting the PostgreSQL disk volume and causing write failures that result in order errors and export timeouts.
truth: A new data export job runs every minute and writes large CSV files to /var/lib/postgresql/exports, filling the 50 GB database disk so PostgreSQL cannot write new data.
